job_description.title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend
job_description.description: We are looking for an experienced Senior Backend Engineer to join our core platform team. You will design, build, and scale high-performance distributed systems that power millions of daily transactions.
responsibilities: Design and implement scalable microservices using Go and Kotlin
Own end-to-end features from technical design to production deployment
Improve system reliability, performance, and observability
Lead technical decisions and mentor junior engineers
Collaborate with product, data, and infrastructure teams
Participate in on-call rotation (generous compensation provided)

must_have: Strong proficiency in Go, Kotlin, or Java
Experience with Kubernetes and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP)
Deep knowledge of distributed systems and databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Redis)
Track record of building high-throughput, low-latency services

benefits: Top-tier health, dental, and vision insurance
